svg.title: Deciding the assurance level
svg.desc: Score each dimension 1 low to 4 very high. Take the highest of each, and read the level where they meet.

div.span: Score each dimension 1 low to 4 very high. Take the highest of each, and read the level where they meet.

div.b: WHY THE TOP ROW DOES NOT VARY

div.span: A 4 on any one impact dimension is the Business Critical test, whatever the likelihood.
